title: True group commit moonshot
impact: Moonshot: Wrapping a coalesced standalone write burst in one SQLite transaction makes the focused concurrent-burst lane roughly 8x faster (-88.1% / -87.3%) while sequential writes and explicit transaction guardrails stay neutral. Rejected as a hidden default because it changes independent-autocommit visibility, durability, and failure semantics; prototype preserved at `archive/exp-197`.
